description: This PHP class represents an entity for import error records related to internationalization (i18n) within the OrangeHRM system. It defines the ORM mapping for the database table 'ohrm_i18n_import_error' and includes properties for various related entities such as language string, language, error, and the employee who imported the record, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: I18NImportError
classes.description: Entity class mapping to the 'ohrm_i18n_import_error' table, representing an import error related to internationalization, including foreign key relationships to language string, language, error, and employee entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the import error record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the import error record.

methods.name: getLangString
methods.description: Retrieves the associated language string entity.

methods.name: setLangString
methods.description: Assigns a language string entity to this import error.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language entity related to this import error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error entity related to this import error.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Sets the error entity for this import error.

methods.name: getImportedBy
methods.description: Gets the employee who imported the record.

methods.name: setImportedBy
methods.description: Assigns the employee who imported the record.
